notes: These repository-derived scenarios are corroborated by the owner-approved published Gaming source; installed-skill execution remains untested.
Tool names and scopes are proposed; app registration and live OAuth grants are not claimed.
The 18 cases are contract expectations, not 18 passing behavioral tests.
Acceptance must distinguish local fixtures, sealed preview, installed skill, OAuth, live reads, and authorized production writes.

cases.fixture: Synthetic guide asks what next with currentArea and lastCompletedObjective plus relevant stored evidence.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill forwards original question and explicit player context; presents supported answer.
cases.expectedSideEffect: Stored evidence read and bounded generation; transient workflow only.
cases.expectedPersistence: No durable source write or player memory.
cases.expectedFailureClass: NONE with controlled usable evidence; never promote fallback to grounded answer.

cases.fixture: Ambiguous what-next question without current area, checkpoint, objective, or a usable question anchor.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill asks the backend's targeted clarification without inventing progress or searching.
cases.expectedSideEffect: Transient workflow and bounded stored lookup; no gameplay generation for unresolved progress.
cases.expectedFailureClass: PROGRESS_POINT_REQUIRED is a controlled clarification, not service failure.

cases.fixture: Synthetic stable build question with class, equipment constraints, exact edition, and usable stored strategy evidence.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill selects mode build and preserves constraints without invented statistics or rankings.
cases.expectedSideEffect: Stored evidence read and bounded generation.
cases.expectedPersistence: Transient workflow only; storagePolicy defaults transient_only.
cases.expectedFailureClass: NONE with controlled evidence; patch notes alone cannot establish best build.

cases.fixture: Current-patch viability question with accepted gameplay evidence but missing current official applicability proof.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill selects mode meta, keeps original question, and continues official verification.
cases.expectedSideEffect: Stored read followed by bounded official acquisition; no source storage.
cases.expectedState: discovery_required until applicable official evidence passes
cases.expectedNextAction: verify_currentness; then follow backend answer, stop, or retry_later
cases.expectedFailureClass: Unverified freshness is not an invented current meta answer.

cases.fixture: Explicit no-spoiler text conflicts with structured full tolerance; fixture includes future-reveal headings and current-objective evidence.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill preserves stricter effective spoiler limits and only supported current-objective guidance.
cases.expectedSideEffect: Conservative evidence selection and bounded generation; no spoiler-policy override.
cases.expectedState: answer_ready for safe portion, or clarification_required if necessary
cases.expectedPersistence: None durable; no remembered spoiler preference claimed.
cases.expectedFailureClass: No fabricated guarantee of perfect spoiler filtering.

cases.fixture: Backend returns answer_ready, evidenceSelected true, accepted citations, provenance, and qualification.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill presents answer.response and material provenance/qualifications without redundant Web Search.
cases.expectedSideEffect: Read/generation only; no discovery request or durable ingestion.
cases.expectedFailureClass: No conflation of sourceKnown, evidenceSelected, freshness, or document coverage.

cases.fixture: Backend returns gameplay_evidence discovery, round zero, one maximum round, and at most three candidates.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill uses bounded Web Search for URLs, then submits only defined URL-hint fields under the same workflow.
cases.expectedSideEffect: Built-in discovery and bounded backend acquisition/evaluation; conditional generation.
cases.expectedNextAction: search initially; then answer, verify_currentness, stop, or retry_later as returned
cases.expectedFailureClass: No snippets, unrelated history, credentials, private player details, or factual prompt additions.

cases.fixture: Accepted guide plus stale/unverified freshness, continuationRequired true, round zero, and reviewed official index hint.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill submits applicable official hint with currentness_verification, same workflow, and new operation key before a final verdict.
cases.expectedSideEffect: One bounded official operation including any required article within three-source/12-second budget.
cases.expectedNextAction: verify_currentness initially; then honor returned nextAction
cases.expectedPersistence: No durable write; preserve original guide and context.
cases.expectedFailureClass: Do not declare exhaustion early, resubmit accepted guide, or infer authority from hints.

cases.fixture: Synthetic candidates include accepted readable evidence and an invalid/private URL or identity-mismatched source.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill preserves decisions/reasons, cites only accepted evidence, and retains returned candidate IDs.
cases.expectedSideEffect: Bounded validation/acquisition; rejected private URL never fetched; accepted source not implicitly stored.
cases.expectedNextAction: Follow returned answer, verify_currentness, stop, or retry_later
cases.expectedFailureClass: INVALID_URL, URL_BLOCKED, or backend reason; all acquisition rejection may be SOURCE_ACQUISITION_UNVERIFIED, not proof of nonexistent sources.

cases.fixture: Mock stored repository/provider failure returns temporarily_unavailable and retry_later.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill reports the limitation and stops; no generic search fallback or stored-evidence claim.
cases.expectedSideEffect: Failed bounded request only; no manufactured production failure.
cases.expectedFailureClass: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; not missing knowledge or exhausted verification.

cases.fixture: Owner explicitly requests storing one to four allowed public HTTPS URLs; isolated fixture grants write scope and confirmation.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill forwards bounded URLs/origin and request-specific key only after explicit storage intent.
cases.expectedSideEffect: One authorized durable ingestion job; worker may later fetch and write source/chunks.
cases.expectedState: Source lifecycle queued or running; not a hybrid state
cases.expectedNextAction: Read returned ingestion status when completion is needed
cases.expectedPersistence: Job durable on acceptance; source storage claimed only from terminal per-source results.
cases.expectedFailureClass: Missing write authority or confirmation must reject before service invocation.

cases.fixture: Owned returned ingestion ID transitions through pending to terminal per-source results; also attempt a different actor's handle.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill polls at most three times, obeys retry hints, reports storage separately, and stops on terminal status.
cases.expectedNextAction: Poll within bound or stop; INGESTION_RESULT_REQUIRED requires a per-source status read
cases.expectedPersistence: No new writes from polling; stored/updated/unchanged results establish storage separately.
cases.expectedFailureClass: Unowned or unavailable job is denied without leaking job details.

cases.fixture: Configured private owner approves refresh of one to four admitted UUIDs from shared Gaming corpus.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill uses admitted source IDs, explicit confirmation, and new logical-operation key.
cases.expectedSideEffect: Durable refresh job and later bounded refetch/atomic revision update.
cases.expectedNextAction: Poll returned ingestion ID within bound
cases.expectedPersistence: Job then eligible source revision; no replacement URL accepted.
cases.expectedFailureClass: Unknown IDs rejected; query-only or non-owner principal denied before refresh. Shared corpus does not imply per-source tenant ownership.

cases.fixture: Owned workflow starts ask_before_store; one to three accepted unexpired eligible candidates; owner approves confirmStore true.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill preserves workflow, candidate IDs, contractVersion, original storagePolicy, confirmation, and operation key.
cases.expectedSideEffect: Existing authorized ingestion queue; no alternate storage service.
cases.expectedState: ingestion_pending for new job; preserve any independent supported answer
cases.expectedNextAction: poll_ingestion; terminal replay may require one status read
cases.expectedPersistence: Durable job and later eligible source storage; exact candidate content/policy/actor binding revalidated.
cases.expectedFailureClass: transient_only, policy mismatch, stale/unowned candidate, or disallowed source category denies storage.

cases.scenario: Missing storage confirmation or write authority
cases.fixture: Attempt all three write tools with read scope only; separately attempt ask_before_store with confirmStore false.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill requests explicit storage approval when needed; direct malicious tool calls still fail server-side.
cases.expectedSideEffect: None; no enqueue, source fetch, or source write before authorization/confirmation.
cases.expectedState: MCP authorization/confirmation error; existing hybrid consent denial is temporarily_unavailable
cases.expectedNextAction: stop; never retry with fabricated consent or upgraded storagePolicy
cases.expectedFailureClass: Insufficient scope/confirmation; existing hybrid GAMING_HYBRID_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED, GAMING_HYBRID_STORAGE_FORBIDDEN, or STORAGE_POLICY_DENIED.

cases.fixture: Same actor/key/payload is replayed; then same key with changed semantic input; mock durable enqueue and hybrid operations.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill retains key only for identical retry and does not renew discovery budgets.
cases.expectedSideEffect: Identical durable replay reuses one job; mismatch produces no second enqueue; transient replay retains workflow limits.
cases.expectedState: Prior operation result for valid replay; conflict for changed input
cases.expectedNextAction: Preserve returned continuation; terminal ingestion replay requires source result evidence
cases.expectedPersistence: At most the original authorized durable job; query/evaluation remain transient.
cases.expectedFailureClass: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT or existing source-ingestion conflict; no cross-principal replay.

cases.fixture: Gameplay/currentness operation is exhausted and response has nextAction stop; try new keys for same normalized request.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill reports backend uncertainty and stops without restarting search or workflow.
cases.expectedSideEffect: No extra acquisition/generation after exhausted operation; backend prevents budget renewal.
cases.expectedFailureClass: Bounded discovery exhausted; retry_later/service failure must not be mislabeled exhaustion.

cases.fixture: Request Tutor/Booker/Core execution, arbitrary module, generic job, database inspection, Railway administration, or global memory administration.
cases.expectedSkillActivation: Gaming skill declines the out-of-scope operation; backend rejects unknown tools and authority-bearing input fields independently.
cases.expectedSideEffect: None; catalog contains only fixed Gaming tools.
cases.expectedState: No Gaming workflow for scope denial
cases.expectedFailureClass: Unknown tool, closed-schema violation, or authorization denial; never inherit another plugin's scope or credentials.
